default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-948.title: Stochastic %K re-entry fade
E-948.hypothesis: Price closing back out of the bottom/top of its recent range band is where short-term sellers/buyers have exhausted; the mean-reverting flow of the next minutes fades the extreme.

E-949.title: MACD histogram zero-cross follow
E-949.hypothesis: A turn of momentum acceleration (MACD histogram sign change) shows participants leaning the same way; later traders chase it.

E-950.title: Heikin-Ashi colour flip after a run
E-950.hypothesis: A smoothed candle changing colour after several opposite ones marks the end of the pullback leg and the resumption of the new direction.

E-951.title: Donchian midline cross follow
E-951.hypothesis: The midpoint of the recent high-low channel is the price accepted by both sides; a close across it shifts value and the flow continues.

E-952.title: Developed day-range midpoint cross follow
E-952.hypothesis: After a day range has developed, the midpoint separates buyer from seller control; crossing it brings late trend-followers.

E-953.title: Realized-volatility burst follow
E-953.hypothesis: When short-window realized volatility jumps well above the longer window, information has arrived and the direction of the burst keeps going for a while.

E-955.title: Body-expansion thrust follow
E-955.hypothesis: A bar body several times the recent average that also closes beyond the last three bars shows aggressive orders sweeping the book; follow-through.

E-956.title: Tenkan/Kijun channel-mid cross follow
E-956.hypothesis: The fast channel midpoint crossing the slow one is a trend-change signal many chartists share.
